products.title: Bar Stool - Voluptas
products.description_html: Internal structure in plywood, seat and back padding in polyurethane with differentiated densities and acrylic layer. Back panel composed of three cylindrical bands curved and individually upholstered. Rotating stainless steel base consisting of a turned leg, The metal parts are available in the metallic finishes selection.

products.title: Bar Stool - Sunny
products.description_html: Upholstered stool with frame in polished stainless steel, structure of the curved backrest and seat in plywood. Padding in polyurethane in different densities. Main upholstery in leather or fabric. Metal parts available in the met- al finishing selection.

products.title: Bar Stool - Kylo
products.description_html: External structure in curved wood, with legs in conic metal tube and turned feet. Quilted upholstery in leather or fabric and matching pipings on the edges. Metal parts can be lacquered in any colour included in the metal ﬁnish selection.
